data.regulation: MDR s.26  No sale or import of unlicensed devices
summaryList:
Risk 2:
The company imported, sold and/or offered for sale medical device(s) that were not authorised for sale by Health Canada.

Risk 2:
Labels on one or more medical devices available for sale in Canada did not set out the required information and/or the information was incorrect.

data.regulation: MDR s.27 (a) No advertising of unlicensed devices
summaryList:
Risk 2:
The company advertised medical device(s) that were not authorised for sale on its website and/or in its catalog.

data.regulation: MDR s.53  Sufficient information for complete and rapid recall
summaryList:
Risk 1:
The company's distribution records did not have enough information to allow for a complete and rapid withdrawal of the medical devices from the marketplace.

Risk 2:
The company did not provide a complete and/or accurate list of the names and/or addresses of the manufacturers of the medical devices that were being imported or distributed in Canada on its establishment licence application.

Risk 2:
The written procedure for distribution records was inadequate.

data.regulation: MDR s.45 (i) Handling, storage, delivery, etc.
summaryList:

The written procedure(s) for handling, storage, delivery, installation, and/or servicing of medical devices were inadequate.

data.regulation: MDR s.52 (1) Distribution records per device
summaryList:
